# slogan

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:slogan`](gmeow-slogan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slogan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A promotional tagline or motto an agent presents itself by — the short marketing phrase of an organization (or person/brand). A flat, displayable literal (language-tagged where relevant); NOT a gmeow:Appellation/name. Non-functional in practice but unconstrained. Projects to [schema:slogan.](https://schema.org/slogan.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry an agent's promotional tagline or motto — a short marketing phrase displayed as-is.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the agent's name (a name is a structured [`gmeow:OrganizationName`](../classes/gmeow-OrganizationName.md) / [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) in the names slice) and avoid an untagged literal where a language is known.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:slogan`](gmeow-slogan.md) to a language-tagged literal on the agent; keep names on [`gmeow:hasOrganizationName`](gmeow-hasOrganizationName.md) and let this carry only the marketing phrase.

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:slogan`](gmeow-slogan.md) "Widgets that work"@en.
